subject: Action needed: Mia's camper info form (due May 15)
body_text:
Hi families!

We're so excited for summer! To finish Mia's registration for Session 2, please reply to this email with the following information by May 15:

- Camper full name
- Date of birth
- Grade entering in the fall
- T-shirt size (youth S/M/L)
- Swimming ability (non-swimmer / beginner / intermediate / advanced)
- Any allergies or medical conditions we should know about
- Emergency contact name and phone number
- Parent/guardian signature confirming you've read the camp policies

Thanks!
The Camp Wildwood Team

subject: Complete Leo's online registration form

subject: Your CampDoc health forms are now open
body_text:
Dear Parent,

The health history and medication forms for Pine Lake Camp are now available in your CampDoc account. Please log in to complete them by June 1:

https://app.campdoc.example/login

Forms include the annual health history, immunization records, and a physician-signed physical exam. You will need your account password to access them.

Thank you,
Pine Lake Camp Health Team

subject: 5 things to pack for a great summer ☀️
body_text: Summer is almost here! Here are our top packing tips: sunscreen, a reusable water bottle, sturdy shoes, a hat, and a positive attitude. No action needed — just getting you excited! See you soon.
